    <script type="text/javascript">
        function findByTextSearch() {
            $('.m-fleet-bound tr').removeClass('currentHidden');
            $('.m-fleet-bound tr').removeClass('isGo');
            var route = $('#txtRoute').val().trim().toLowerCase();
            var enterprise = $('#txtEnterprise').val().trim().toLowerCase();
            
            var road = $('#txtRoad').val().trim().toLowerCase();
           
            if (route === '' && enterprise === '' && road === '') {
                $('.m-fleet-bound tr').show();
            } else {
                $('.m-fleet-bound tr').hide();
                if (enterprise !== '') {
                    $('.txtEnterprise-search').each(function () {
                        var hs = $('.' + $(this).parent().attr('class'));
                        if ($(this).html().toLowerCase().indexOf(enterprise) >= 0 && !hs.hasClass('currentHidden')) {
                            hs.show();
                        } else {
                            hs.hide();
                            if (!hs.hasClass('currentHidden')) {
                                hs.addClass('currentHidden');
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }

                if (route !== '') {
                    $('.txtRoute-search').each(function () {
                        var hs = $('.' + $(this).parent().attr('class'));
                        if ($(this).html().toLowerCase().indexOf(route) >= 0 && !hs.hasClass('currentHidden')) {
                            hs.show();
                        } else {
                            hs.hide();
                            if (!hs.hasClass('currentHidden')) {
                                hs.addClass('currentHidden');
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }

                if (road !== '') {
                    $('.txtRoad-go-search').each(function () {
                        var hs = $('.' + $(this).parent().attr('class'));
                        if ($(this).html().toLowerCase().indexOf(road) >= 0 && !hs.hasClass('currentHidden')) {
                            hs.addClass('isGo');
                            hs.show();
                        }
                    });

                    $('.txtRoad-back-search').each(function () {
                        var hs = $('.' + $(this).parent().attr('class'));
                        if ($(this).html().toLowerCase().indexOf(road) >= 0 && !hs.hasClass('currentHidden')) {
                            hs.show();
                        } else {
                            if (!hs.hasClass('isGo')) {
                                hs.hide();
                            }
                          
                            if (!hs.hasClass('currentHidden')) {
                                hs.addClass('currentHidden');
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }
            }
        }
    </script>

    $(document).ready(function() {
        
        var availableTags = JSON.parse($('.hdfInfoRouteCss').text());//Lấy các điểm trong
        //*sign
        $("#banner-search-key").autocomplete({
            source: availableTags,
            minLength: 1
        });
    });
    //*sign
    function changeSearchType(obj) {
        var availableTags;
        var minLength = 1;
        switch ($('#banner-search-type').val()) {
            case "1":
               availableTags = JSON.parse($('.hdfInfoRouteCss').text());
            break;
            case "2":
                availableTags = JSON.parse($('.hdfInfoStopCss').text());
                minLength = 3;
                break;
            case "3":
                availableTags = JSON.parse($('.hdfInfoTicketsCss').text());
                minLength = 3;
                break;
            case "4":
                availableTags = JSON.parse($('.hdfInfoParkCss').text());
                minLength = 3;
                break;
            case "5":
                availableTags = JSON.parse($('.hdfInfoTravelCss').text());
                minLength = 3;
                break;
            default:
                availableTags = [];
                break;
        }
        
        $("#banner-search-key").autocomplete({
            source: availableTags,
            minLength: minLength,
            max: 20,
            scroll: true
        });

        TSC.changeSearchType(obj);
    }
</script>
